subject: Tenant commissioning: preflight questions, network evidence, and action items
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika@lumacare.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Meyer <jason.meyer@lumacare.com>, Network Ops <netops@lumacare.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Tenant commissioning kickoff for Lumacare - what you need from us

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We're ready to start the private deployment onboarding with Redwood for our Lumacare tenant. Before we schedule any hands-on sessions, can you confirm the exact account & network items you need from us to pass the initial gate?

High level questions from our side:
- Do you need a dedicated service account and IAM roles created by our team, or will Redwood create service principals on our behalf (we prefer to own identities)?
- Which ports and egress ranges should we plan to allow for the initial smoke test?
- Requirements for KMS/HSM integrations and who needs to provide pubkeys/certs.
- Any preferred CIDR sizes or peering requirements for on-prem edge connectors.

I've attached our current IP inventory and a short network diagram (lumacare-internal-network-ips.csv). We'll follow up with more detail after your checklist.

Can we aim to get the checklist today so we can align procurement and infra?

Thanks,
Anika Rao
CTO, Lumacare Health

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika@lumacare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant commissioning kickoff for Lumacare - what you need from us

Hi Anika — great to hear you're ready to move. Below is a concise intake checklist and the minimal evidence we need for the preflight gate. I kept items grouped so your infra and security teams can split work.

Redwood private deploy intake checklist (minimum for commissioning)
1) Account & Identity
   - Confirm whether Lumacare will create cloud service accounts/roles (recommended) or permit Redwood-managed principals.
   - Provide list of admin and ops emails for RBAC.
   - Provide expected account IDs (cloud project/account numbers).
2) Network & Connectivity
   - Provide VPC/subnet CIDRs and a sample VPC config (yaml or Terraform).
   - Public egress ranges and NAT gateway IPs (we will add to allowlist).
   - Ports to allow: TCP 443 outbound, health TCP 3000-3005 for test harness (adjustable), SSH 22 only to bastion IPs if needed.
   - Peering/Transit: describe whether you prefer VPC peering, PrivateLink, or VPN.
3) Secrets & Encryption
   - KMS key ARN or HSM contact point; do you require CMKs in customer account?
   - TLS cert or ACME plan for service endpoints.
4) Compliance Evidence
   - SOC2 or ISO artifacts needed for our internal acceptance (redact PII).
   - Audit log forwarding plan (S3/Cloud Storage bucket or SIEM endpoint).
5) Test plan & handoffs
   - Planned canary window (2 hours) and escalation contact.
   - Sample test data (sanitized) and expected throughput for ramp.

Action items for Lumacare to return to us: full VPC sample config, NAT egress IPs, confirmation on service account ownership, KMS details, and a preferred canary date.

I've attached a compact intake checklist PDF you can send to your network team: redwood-privdeploy-intake-checklist-v1.pdf

If you prefer, Ben can run a 30-minute network Q&A today at 3pm PT. Ben?

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-privdeploy-intake-checklist-v1.pdf (pdf, 18KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika@lumacare.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant commissioning kickoff for Lumacare - what you need from us

Hi Anika — I can take the network Q&A. Two quick clarifications ahead of a call:
- Do you have an existing NAT gateway with stable egress IPs, or are those ephemeral today? Stable IPs simplify our allowlist and health checks.
- For the on-prem edge connector: are you running an outbound-only connector (recommended) or inbound VPN termination?
- If you're using private DNS domains internally, do you have split-horizon DNS we should be aware of?

Suggested 30-min agenda for today's call:
1) Review VPC sample config & CIDRs (10m)
2) Egress IPs and firewall rules (10m)
3) KMS footprint and audit log endpoint (5m)
4) Next steps and canary window (5m)

If 3pm PT works for you, I'll send a calendar invite with a short runbook.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 10:18 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Anika — great to hear you're ready to move. Below is a concise intake checklist and the minimal evidence we need for the preflight gate.
> 
> Redwood private deploy intake checklist (minimum for commissioning)
> ...

Thanks — answering inline and attaching a sample VPC config and our current CIDR map.

1) Service accounts: we'll create the cloud service account(s) and provide role ARNs. We prefer to retain ownership.
2) Egress IPs: currently we have two static NAT IPs: 3.101.45.22 and 3.101.45.23. We'll add those to the allowlist.
3) Connector type: outbound-only edge connector (will initiate TLS to Redwood public endpoint).
4) KMS: We will provide a customer-managed CMK ARN; key is in our account.
5) DNS: we run split-horizon for internal names; there are no overlapping domains with Redwood endpoints.
6) Canary window: Preferred dates: Mar 22–24, target window 03/23 10:00–12:00 PT.

Attachments included: lumacare-vpc-sample-config.yaml (yaml, 9KB)

Let us know if you need anything else before the call. Jason
Jason Meyer
VP Engineering, Lumacare Health

Subject: Re: Tenant commissioning kickoff for Lumacare - what you need from us

Thanks for the fast turnaround, Jason. This aligns with our gating criteria. Two quick operational notes and next steps before we consider the environment "commissioned":

1) Procurement/contracting: I'll confirm that the DL-4729 scope covers private deploy canary work and send a short amendment for the canary dates. Expect a DocuSign link from procurement.
2) Scheduling: we tentatively book the canary for 2028-03-23 10:00–12:00 PT; please confirm by EOD Monday 3/19 if that window still works.
3) Evidence to attach to the commissioning ticket: VPC YAML (done), NAT egress IPs (done), CMK ARN (pending), SOC2 redacted snapshot (if available).
4) Operational contact during canary: provide two escalation contacts (names + cell numbers) and a Slack channel if you have one.

Ben and Vivek will join the canary and monitor metrics. Once Lumacare returns the CMK ARN and confirmation on the procurement amendment, we'll move the environment to 'commissioning-ready' and run the smoke tests.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123 (procurement amendment)
On-call runbook (internal): https://redwood.app/ops/runbooks/canary

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Program Manager, Customer Operations — Redwood Inference
